baseline.holdoutRule: The v1-v10 holdouts were promoted to regression after evaluation. The two v11 real-network holdouts were selected, truth-labelled and frozen after correcting the gate and image pipeline, but before either was submitted to the candidate profile. They are developer-visible, non-adaptive holdouts rather than an independently sealed or blinded evaluation set, and must not be used to revise and re-score the same candidate.

invariants: Only containers carrying the BCRS Deposit Mark are eligible for a refund.
The refund is S$0.10 per eligible container.
Containers without the mark remain recyclable through blue bins or other recycling stations.
The scheme product-approval guide distinguishes the product barcode from the separate square 2D traceability code printed on some approved labels.
